overall.summary: Physician's Solution appears to be a broad ambulatory EHR/PM/RCM product family, but its registered ONC EHI-export documentation endpoint is unreachable and no export artifacts were retrievable. As a result, coverage, format, and fidelity assessments cannot be validated and the product is currently marked insufficiently documented with unknown domain-level coverage.

notableFacts: Registered EHI URL in evidence is https://mraemr.com:47102/api/DataExportGuidance.asp, which was unreachable (connection refused).
CHPL-linked documentation path https://mraemr.com:47102/api/mandatory_disclosure.asp also resolved to an unreachable endpoint.
Alternative access to mraemr.com root used in validation showed SSL certificate validity issues and required bypass flags for curl.
Marketing page mdchartsehr.com/why-mdcharts/ links to CHPL and mandatory disclosures but does not expose EHI-export specs or data dictionaries.

Product-research context indicates broad scope including clinical notes, labs, imaging workflows, scheduling, insurance, billing/claims, and portal functions, increasing risk that export scope gaps would be meaningful if export is unverified.
